name: Dominant Witches
source:
You play as a student of a magical academy who was sent to an internship in a fortress located in the middle of nowhere. You meet there three witches and an innkeeper. Also in the game will be succubus, vampire and kitsune who live outside the fortress.

[From [url=https://nikociantgames.itch.io/dominant-witches]Itch.io[/url]]
